title: Do not spend a rare life like loose change
summary: The line gives purpose back to the day by refusing drift its usual authority. Let this stay near the next choice: let this stay with you: treat this life as a meeting, not an endless postponement.
takeaway: Use this day for what can still remain.
lifeApplication: When aimlessness starts thinning the day, let one concrete act answer the question of why you were given this body.

source.shortMeaning: Human life is rare meeting ground, not spare time to waste.
source.lifeApplication: Before drifting into another task, choose one act that treats life as opportunity.
